 FROM ((SELECT d.trade_date,u.ts_code FROM ((SELECT DISTINCT trade_date FROM stk_limit ORDER BY trade_date) TIMESTAMP(trade_date)) d
 CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ts_code FROM stk_factor) u ORDER BY d.trade_date) TIMESTAMP(trade_date)) x
 ASOF JOIN stk_factor f ON (x.ts_code=f.ts_code)
